headline: CVS Announces Drugstore Business Spinoff; Shares Plunge 12 Percent
summary: CVS announced plans to separate its drugstore chain into a new listed company to improve operational focus, triggering a 12 percent drop in its share price as markets reacted negatively.
why: Corporate spin-offs of core business units alter a company's capital structure, asset backing, and growth profile, frequently driving significant near-term equity volatility.

impacts.name: CVS Health Corp.
impacts.why: Market reaction to the planned drugstore division spin-off caused a sharp decline in equity valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors reacted negatively to the announcement of the drugstore chain spin-off, driving a sharp sell-off in the company's shares.
